note: Measured 2026-11-13 on an Apple M2, headless Chrome 157, local server, with live Mapbox routing and tiles tokens. Public transport fields from the T-01 build 2026-11-12 (uncleared, served with TRANSIT_ALLOW_UNCLEARED=1 to this machine only), with the 2 km walking near field (sources 'mapbox+tables'). Self-tests run on real Streets v8 tiles (geom=tiles).

live_mapbox_isochrones_kings_cross.request: denoise=0, polygons=true; nested means each contour leaves under 1% of the one inside it outside

fields_kings_cross.build_cpu_ms: server field maths only, on the live polygons, best of 3; endpoint_ms_cold includes the two Mapbox calls

transit_fields_wd08.note: the grid spans the whole coverage box; endpoint_ms_cold includes the two walking isochrone calls

near_field_seam_wd08.measure: |t(r+50 m) - t(r-50 m)| over 360 bearings, median / p90 minutes

tfl_journeys_wd08.note: field value at the destination station (bilinear at the station's position) from a pin at the start station; 'no endings' is the walkshed composition alone, before the table-point and station endings

baker-street_to_wembley-park.tfl_source: Journey Planner 940GZZLUBST to 940GZZLUWYP, six departures 08:00-08:50, median

new_pin_normal_bands.includes: two live isochrone calls, the server build, decode, worker contouring

walking_kings_cross.first_bend_includes: scene (19 tiles, cold) and band layer, then the 300 ms fade and 1.8 s morph

new_pin_while_bent.includes: field, scene and band layer; swapped in place, already bent

squash_trial.note: code at 3c4a2f6 + e54f1ad; transit, weekday 08-09, by reach (spread 0.5), T = 45; shares of the places within T minutes (true minutes, filled ground left out), drawn where each layout puts them (static/shared/mesh/diagnostics.js layoutChecks). Not Direction 4's metric.

uncertain_checks.note: Uncertain patches on live fields (server/warp/field.py, single-node slivers included) and enclosedFade before (the field's own minutes) and after (the geometry field the fold bends by). Counts only: patch locations are not stored.

Shares of sampled places (every second node).

first_scene_ms_baker_street.setup: desktop 1440x900, headless Chrome with GPU, wd08, 45 min, by reach, tiles in the browser cache, new page each run, prepareMesh to the whole scene installed (S.timings scene); one run of eleven returned no data and is left out
